A treat for this travelling author
Mar 2025 • Solo
I spied some mixed reviews recently on Trip Advisor for Lubu, so approached it with some trepidation, in spite of the fact that it had been recommended to me by business acquaintances at the British School. I needn't have worried.

The service was attentive but unobtrusive and the food delicious. I'll happily call back later in the week to try another dish (or two). Thanks for the hospitality and splendid dinner for this solo traveller.

Excellent value lunch at this lovely place in Thao Dien
Jan 2021
Had a great lunch with 3 colleagues ( one of whom is regular there) at Lubu which had a lovely ambiance in a very greek style. The set menu for 280,000 vnd ( with no ++added ) with a glass of French white or red (an additional 80,000) was superb. i had the Gazpacho which was really tasty and my friends went for the salad.
The chicken cotoletta i had for main was enormous and excellent. My 3 colleagues chose the minute steak, the Morrocan tagine and the gnocchi and licked their plates clean.Although Lubu's panna cotta was the only desert option it was light and tasty . We finished with coffees which are included free of charge. I must compliment the staff who were low key but attentive just the way they should be.

Sad
Dec 2020 • Friends
We used to frequent Lubu as the food was of a solid and consistent standard. So when the opportunity came to entertain friends we thought this would be a solid restaurant selection. We were very wrong.

We sat outside and the sewerage smell coming from the equipment adjacent to the toilet wall was horrible. 

The wine we ordered was not cheap due to the quality and the waitress broke the glass of the lip of the bottle on opening. No offer to replace or assist us with this.

The food was horrible and the standards we knew are long gone. Portions were small and very pricey. The staff spent most of our dinner on their phones. 

We will never return. Shame.

Delightful and delicious!
Nov 2019
Set back from the street, the feeling is very much of an appealing Mediterranean terrace and so both times I have visited this week, I have sat outside.
The first time I came for dinner I had the vegetarian souvlaki and mushroom pasta - both of which were sublime! This morning I returned for breakfast (haloumi, hummus and pickled beetroot followed by churros) and was similarly sated!
The staff are helpful and friendly in equal measure and the experience is a wonderful combination of excellent atmosphere, food and service. I only have a week of work left in Ho Chi Minh, but will definitely be visiting again.
